kept.title_or_quote: API functionality (feature request on Uptime Kuma)
kept.why_relevant: Dozens of users asking a competitor for a management API — pingdeck's headline differentiator.

rescore.why: The thread is explicitly requesting Terraform and API-driven monitor management for Uptime Kuma, which is precisely what this app ships as a core differentiator.

kept.drafted_reply: The core ask here — adding and managing monitors via API or Terraform without click-ops — is exactly what's been blocking Uptime Kuma adoption for infra-as-code workflows. If you need this today rather than waiting on a contribution, the pattern is: a monitoring tool with a full REST API and an official Terraform provider in the registry, so monitors live in the same repo as the infrastructure they watch. That sidesteps the socket-based API workarounds people have been patching together in this thread. I built pingdeck ({APP_URL}) with this workflow as the starting point, not an afterthought, if it's useful as a reference or alternative.
